title: CoilDef
description: Canonical coil definition. The coil type is determined solely by geometry.type. No top-level type field. No stored normal vector — n̂ is derived from rotationEulerDeg in physics code only. filamentPaths is not stored here; it is transient output from /api/discretise.

groupId.description: ID of the group this coil belongs to, or null.

colour.description: CSS hex colour string (e.g. '#ff6600'), or null to use the default.

locked.description: When true, the coil cannot be edited or moved until explicitly unlocked.

center.description: Centroid of the coil in the global Z-up frame, metres.

rotationEulerDeg.description: ZYX intrinsic Euler angles in degrees. Identity (0,0,0) = coil lies in XY plane, axis = +Z. n̂ is derived from this in physics code; it is never stored.

geometry.description: Type-discriminated geometry parameters. geometry.type is the sole coil-type discriminator.

turns.description: Total number of wire turns, summed across all layers.

current.description: Signed amperes. Positive = CCW from +n̂ (right-hand rule). Negate to reverse field direction.

channelWidth.description: Internal width of the U-channel in metres. Packing uses wire.insulatedD against this value.

windingMode.description: Required when geometry.type is 'toroidal' or 'elongated_toroidal'; must be null or absent for all other geometry types. Describes how turns are arranged on the torus surface.

radius.description: Distance from center to wire centerline, metres. Circumference = 2πr.

straightLength.description: Length of one straight segment, metres. Total straight run = 2 × straightLength. Circumference = 2πr + 2L.

arcRadius.description: Radius of the semicircular ends, metres.

semiMajor.description: Semi-major axis at wire centerline, metres.

semiMinor.description: Semi-minor axis at wire centerline, metres. Must be <= semiMajor.

WindingMode.description: How turns are arranged on the torus surface. 'poloidal': each turn is a small loop around the tube cross-section; turns distributed evenly along the centreline by arc length. 'toroidal': each turn is a large loop around the torus axis/centreline; turns distributed evenly around the tube cross-section by poloidal angle. Only applies to toroidal-family geometry types.

majorRadius.description: Distance from the torus axis (Z) to the tube centreline, metres. Must be > minorRadius.

minorRadius.description: Radius of the tube cross-section, metres. Must be < majorRadius.

majorRadius.description: Radius of the semicircular ends of the racetrack centreline, metres.

minorRadius.description: Radius of the tube cross-section, metres.

extension.description: Half-length of each straight section of the racetrack centreline, metres.
